title: File:122nd Fighter Wing pilot delivers Slovakia's first F-16s (8549570).jpg
art: U.S. Air National Guard photo by Tech. Sgt. David Sherman
desc: An F-16C Block 70 Fighting Falcon aircraft performs a low pass over Malacky Air Base, Slovakia, July 22, 2024. The aircraft were flown by U.S. Air Force pilots and were the first F-16s to be delivered from Lockheed Martin to Slovakia. (U.S. Air National Guard photo by Tech. Sgt. David Sherman)
